spans.s:
शौच शौच, अम्, n. (fr. शुचि), purification
from personal defilement (especially from defilement
caused by the death of a relation &c.); evacuation of
excrement; freedom from defilement, purity, cleanness;
honesty; (अस्), m. a proper N.
—शौच-कल्प, अस्,
m. mode of purification, purificatory rite.
—शौच-
कूप, अस्, m. ‘cleansing-pit,’ a privy.
—शौच-त्व,
अम्, n. purity.
—शौच-विधि, इस्, m. rule of purifi-
cation (after defilement by the death of a relation
&c.), directions for cleansing the person.
—शौचा-
चार (˚च-आच्˚), अस्, m. a purificatory rite, rule of
purification established by immemorial custom, mode
of cleansing the person by ablution &c. (after voiding
excrement or contracting any defilement).
—शौचेप्सु
(˚च-ईप्˚), उस्, उस्, उ, wishing or intending to obtain
purification.

शौचिक, अस्, m. a cleanser, cleaner; a particular
mixed caste (the son of a Śauṇḍika and a Kaivarta
woman).

सौचीक सौचीक, अस्, m. a patronymic of
the Vedic Ṛṣi Agni.
शौचिवृक्षि, इस्, m., N. of an author.
शौचेय, अस्, m. a washerman; a proper N.

शौचद्रथ शौचद्रथ, अस्, m., Ved. a patro-
nymic of a descendant of Śucad-ratha.

सौचि सौचि, इस्, m. (fr. सूचि; cf. सूचिक),
one who lives by his needle, a tailor.
